title: g-DPO: Scalable Preference Optimization for Protein Language Models
relevance: Uses sequence space clustering to prune redundant protein variants, achieving 1.7-5.4x training speedups. Analogous to beam deduplication in mutation search.
key_finding: Clustering-based pair pruning maintains in silico and in vitro performance while dramatically reducing computational cost.

title: Designing diverse and high-performance proteins with a large language model in the loop
relevance: LLM-in-the-loop protein design generating diverse, high-performance proteins. Demonstrates the value of maintaining diversity during iterative optimization.
key_finding: Language model guidance produces diverse protein designs with high predicted performance.

title: Heuristic Multi-site Optimization for Protein Sequence Design using Masked Protein Language Models
relevance: Heuristic multi-site optimization using masked PLMs for protein design. Directly addresses the multi-position optimization problem with language model scoring.
key_finding: Masked PLM-based heuristic multi-site optimization achieves efficient protein sequence design.
